name: morning_literature_triage_optimized
description: Optimized two-phase literature triage: Phase 1 parallel RSS fetch + priority sort, Phase 2 serial Zotero import respecting API rate limits and file locks. Replaces JOB-701 after workflow optimization on 2026-01-10.
notes: Implemented after rate-limit analysis (OBSN-23) determined bottleneck was RSS serial fetching, not Zotero API quota. Phase 1: parallel fetch from 5 RSS sources (2.5 min). Phase 2: priority-sorted serial Zotero import with batch_size=8, respecting 120 req/min limit (12 sec for 40 papers). Phase 3: serial Obsidian backlink generation (2 min). Total runtime: ~5 min vs 18 min previously. High-priority tags (IL-17, trajectory-analysis, Th17-plasticity, reviewer-response) processed first to ensure dissertation-critical papers available before 09:00 lab arrival.
